Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
Part C2 block sec04-R02 says out-of-state eye care professionals complete Form 412-NC on paper; the manual says only that they complete the form, so the paper medium is an inference, not a printed rule [A02].
The share of fatal collisions involving alcohol and other impairing drugs is given by the manual as an approximate national figure without a named source year, so it is reported as approximate [A05].
The under-twenty-one refusal penalty sits inside the under-twenty-one paragraph of the manual; this dossier does not extend it to adult drivers, whose refusal penalty is not stated in these pages [A07].
Vision certificate validity and form numbers have changed across editions and are isolated as dynamic.
